name: Stop Motion: Location Exterior
description: Image preset for a location exterior in the Stop Motion look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for an exterior establishing shot. Name the location's defining structure, surroundings, time of day, and weather from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: wide exterior establishing view of the location, clear foreground, midground and background, a sense of scale from a figure or doorway, stop-motion puppet animation still, handmade clay and felt puppets with visible fingerprints and stitching, miniature set built from real materials, small practical lamps, shallow depth of field of a macro lens, warm tabletop lighting
negative_prompt: smooth cgi, photorealistic human, flat 2d, digital gloss, motion blur, text, watermark
